node: Small/mid-cap restaurant operators with supplier concentration or related-party procurement
summary: Expanded the node around restaurant procurement dependencies rather than brand-level traffic stories. The strongest underfollowed lead is GEN Restaurant Group because its disclosed food-distributor concentration and related-party supply purchases make it a direct case study in procurement-driven unit economics and governance risk. Second-order public-market mappings include mid/small-cap foodservice suppliers whose economics depend on sticky restaurant inputs: Lamb Weston for frozen potato products and Westrock Coffee for private-label/B2B coffee solutions. Sysco is included only as a reference anchor because it is the obvious large-cap foodservice distributor against which smaller procurement dependencies should be benchmarked. No buy/sell recommendation is made.
